title: Correctness: FIPS gate not first in ioctl_finalize
description: In ioctl_finalize() (crypto2dev_fd.c), the FIPS gate check (ops->fips_gate()) is at line 1401, after: (1) fd_type check (line 1379), (2) finalized check (line 1384), (3) error check (line 1389), (4) iv_set check (line 1395). CLAUDE.md and DESIGN rule state: 'The very first line of every crypto entry point calls crypto2dev_fips_gate(). ... The gate must be the first executable statement — before argument validation, before lock acquisition, before anything else.' and 'One missed gate invalidates the entire CMVP certification.' Trigger: ioctl(fd, FINALIZE) on an fd in FIPS-degraded state — the gate is not checked until after iv_set validation, meaning a non-FIPS code path may branch before the gate fires. FIPS compliance failure: gate must execute before any session state is inspected.
